answer: Enrollment waits on a live root-zone current watch. The applicant posts 28 coins and drives a clerk-serialized 1.1 m copper rod into the drip line of tree 17 in a licensed orchard whose salinity contour is already on-ledger. For 14 minutes a county-banded falcon circles at 80 m with a sealed barometric logger, while the rod records resistivity every 5 s. Peers require the median within 4% of the posted contour and the bird's track hash in the same window. A potting-mix tub or borrowed bird misses both checks, the bond burns, so many names still cost many rods, flights, and trees.
